verdict.rationale: The evidence shows multi-repo sessions only on the cloud path. Cloud Agents support multi-repo environments where the agent can 'inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes, and open pull requests in the repos it changes', and the Cloud Agents API accepts up to 20 repos per agent. Nothing documents including multiple local project directories in an IDE or CLI session. Missing for 10: documented local multi-root/multi-directory support in the editor or CLI, details on how cross-repo context is indexed and used, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
